scope: Integrating review: one new preservation candidate, BLU3797 source-data audit, independent RM4404 challenge

new_candidates.name: Alvelestat for pancreas preservation before islet isolation
new_candidates.novelty_basis: No alvelestat/AZD9668 occurrence in the original inventory, round2 generated proposals, or round3 candidate records. Published use is not claimed to be new to science.
new_candidates.exact_entity: Alvelestat (AZD9668/MPH-966), research material from AdooQ in the source study, as an additive to extracellular-type trehalose-Kyoto pancreas-preservation solution.
new_candidates.functional_evidence: A 2022 primary study compared 10 porcine pancreatic isolations per group. Treated pancreata yielded more islets and higher glucose-stimulated insulin function. At a marginal transplanted islet quantity, 11/20 recipient mice reached the study's glycemic criterion versus1/20 controls; each group of20 mice came from10 isolations, two recipients per isolation.
new_candidates.biological_unit: Ten pancreatic donor/isolation units per group; recipient outcomes are nested two per isolation. Twenty recipients are not20 independent drug-treated donor pancreata.
new_candidates.treatment_timing: Preservation of an already procured organ before a prolonged cold-storage/isolation challenge. This is prevention of additional processing injury, not reversal of established diabetes in the donor or regeneration of lost human islets.
new_candidates.comparator: Same preservation workflow without alvelestat. The paper discusses sivelestat and ulinastatin but does not establish head-to-head superiority over an optimized active preservation regimen.
new_candidates.research_material_route: Defined small molecule and named research supplier in the primary methods. No current stock, received lot, salt/formulation equivalence, GMP supply or residual clearance qualification established in this review.
new_candidates.model_route: Porcine pancreas isolation route is described. Human donor-isolation access has not been secured or independently reproduced here.
new_candidates.exposure_product_gap: Need measured residual drug and NE activity through storage, washout and isolation; preserve digestion performance and viable functional yield at scale.
new_candidates.public_commercial_facts: Mereo and Sentynl announced an option/license agreement for alvelestat in AATD lung disease on11August2026, with Phase3 initiation projected for early2027 conditional on option exercise. That is an active external program, not an islet-use license or approval. NIH lists one related graft-rejection application as abandoned; this does not establish global clearance.
new_candidates.decision: Reserve for an independently differentiated islet-manufacturing proof; does not displace the leading programs.
new_candidates.deciding_proof: Test donor-level functional islet yield and sustained glucose-responsive output against optimized preservation plus an active NE-inhibitor comparator, with blinded allocation, explicit recipient clustering and residual-product clearance.
new_candidates.advance_condition: A reproducible human-relevant increase in usable functional islets, or reduced donor/isolation burden, that remains after washout and exceeds the strongest practical comparator.
new_candidates.stop_condition: Higher counts without useful secretion or graft function, no advantage over an existing preservation additive, or residual and processing burdens that erase the gain.

existing_candidate_updates.new_evidence_delta: Two public patent disclosures describe the matching S upstream intermediate, creating a plausible joined reconstruction route. Newly inspected source workbook verifies strong dose-dependent, ceiling-limited wire-hang observations but exposes an unresolved P22 schedule mismatch in the small late-start comparison, incomplete baseline records, and unlinked panel denominators.
existing_candidate_updates.decision: Retain leading staged human-function proof; improve route-definition confidence and narrow late-treatment evidence interpretation. No S-tier promotion.

independent_challenges.candidate_name: RM4404/WAY-262611 for delayed corneal nerve repair
independent_challenges.conclusion: Useful delayed functional signal merits independent replication. Randomization is reported. The mechanical-injury analysis treats two eyes of a mouse as independent, and its late durability comparisons are often against uninjured animals rather than direct drug-versus-vehicle tests. Supplement S2 supplies explicit drug-versus-vehicle tests, including a one-injured-eye chemical model. Do not claim equivalence to normal or count N22 eye observations as22 mice.
independent_challenges.product_note: Methods describe drug dilution from DMSO stocks into micelles; the high and low drug concentrations imply different DMSO fractions. Drug-free vehicle is described as similarly prepared, but explicit dose-matched solvent composition is not resolved. Treat this as a formulation-control qualification item, not a proven explanation of efficacy.
independent_challenges.deciding_proof: Independent, masked animal-level delayed-treatment replication with characterized formulation and matched vehicle, meaningful active comparator, post-withdrawal sensation, corneal optics and epithelial safety.
independent_challenges.additional_independent_review: A second workstream independently checked the primary paper. Section 2.9 reports blinded secondary imaging review; primary-quantifier and sensory-assessor blinding remain unresolved. At day30 axonal medians357.7 vehicle versus362.1 RM4404 do not demonstrate structural superiority from separate healthy-reference tests. Four days off treatment in the short regimen is not pharmacokinetic washout; do not merge it with the longer mechanical-injury cohort.
